task.title: Validate Scaling and Build-Variant Behavior for Keyword Pop-ups
task.shortdesc: Test key resolution across large map hierarchies and build variants to ensure Insert keyword pop-ups remain consistent at scale.

step.cmd: Measure how many maps/submaps are included under the root map and identify whether keydefs are distributed across many nested levels.
Consolidate widely used key definitions into a dedicated keys map and reference it near the top of the root map to stabilize scope and performance.
Test Insert keyword pop-up behavior with branch filtering enabled for each major build variant to ensure keys remain in scope after filtering.
Check for performance-related timeouts or indexing limits in large projects by comparing behavior in a small subset map versus the full root map.
Establish naming conventions to prevent collisions (for example, prefix keys by product/module) and refactor any ambiguous keys found during scaling tests.
Run a clean build/index refresh after large refactors (moving keydefs, renaming keys, reorganizing maps) and verify Insert keyword suggestions repopulate correctly.

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
